memory_candidates.content: In bash scripts under set -euo pipefail, a `generator | head -c N` pipeline (e.g. `tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' < /dev/urandom | head -c 6` for a random ID suffix) aborts the script: head closing the pipe early after N bytes sends the upstream command a SIGPIPE, and pipefail propagates that as a nonzero pipeline exit status even though head itself succeeded. Fix by appending `|| true` to the pipeline (or by disabling pipefail locally in a subshell). Affects any short random-string generation used for ID suffixes in this codebase's scripts.

Bash parameter expansion default values containing a literal brace pair corrupt non-empty values: `${var:-{}}` used to default an empty JSON-object string to `{}` (e.g. for `jq --argjson`) appends a stray trailing `}` when `var` is already non-empty, producing invalid JSON. Resolve the default via a separate variable assignment (`x="$var"; [ -z "$x" ] && x='{}'`) before passing it to `--argjson` rather than inlining `${var:-{}}`.

Scripts under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ that resolve PROJECT_ROOT via SCRIPT_DIR/../.. (the memory-harvest.sh/memory-retrieve.sh convention) are only correct at their eventual .claude/scripts/ deployment depth (two directories below repo root), not at their three-deep source location under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/. When verifying a newly authored script of this kind during a meta implementation task, exercise it via a temporary local harness at repo-root-plus-one depth (mirroring .claude/scripts/) rather than running it directly from the source tree, and never copy it into .claude/ or .opencode/ to test it -- those are synced deployment copies out of scope for source-tree edits.
